_about: Updates for Sun Nov 8, 2026, checked at 2:03 PM MST against the official Maintainer Summit agenda and the GitHub discussions. All 10 unconference slots now have topics.

howToApply.schedule.json: For each object in sessionUpdates, replace the session with the same id in schedule.json (all fields given). Recompute isMine/hasAnthropicSpeaker at runtime as usual. sessionUpdates.title: Unconference: Surviving the CVE vulnpocalypse
sessionUpdates.description:
containerd has had over 100 times more vulnerability reports in 2026 than in any earlier year. How projects are coping, maintainer burnout, and tools or agent skills worth sharing.

Picked from the community votes (37 votes). Projects: Any CNCF project; containerd.

sessionUpdates.title: Unconference: Evolving Kubernetes for Agentic Workloads: Rethinking the Pod and Node Boundary
sessionUpdates.description:
Agent sandboxes sit idle 90%+ of the time, need 500–1,000 per node and sub-second resume. Where the Pod contract breaks, and what Kubernetes should standardize versus leave to runtimes.

Picked from the community votes (38 votes). Projects: Kubernetes, containerd, CRI-O, Kata, gVisor.

sessionUpdates.title: Unconference: GPU Sandboxes in gVisor: What's Missing and What's Next
sessionUpdates.description:
Agents now write and run their own CUDA. Gaps in gVisor's GPU support: keeping up with driver releases, MIG and multi-node NVLink, GPU checkpoint/restore, and shared CI.

Picked from the community votes (33 votes). Projects: gVisor.

sessionUpdates.title: Unconference: Trust & Triage in the AI Era
sessionUpdates.description:
Keeping trust with users and contributors, finding real contributions in automated noise, and what the contributor ladder means now. Policy changes are in scope.

Picked from the community votes (39 votes). Projects: Kubernetes and any CNCF project.

sessionUpdates.title: Unconference: Graceful Node Shutdown: what it should mean, and how workload controllers find out
sessionUpdates.description:
Settle short-window versus priority-ordered shutdown, publish shutdown state so DaemonSets and drain tooling can react, and draft GA criteria for KEP-2000 and KEP-2712.

Picked from the community votes (17 votes). Projects: SIG Node, SIG Apps, WG Node Lifecycle.

sessionUpdates.title: Unconference: Replacing DevStats
sessionUpdates.description:
DevStats data has been unreliable since February. What should replace it (LFX Insights, CHAOSS, something else) and which community metrics matter to you.

Picked from the community votes (7 votes). Projects: All CNCF.

sessionUpdates.title: Unconference: More PRs, same maintainers. What's helping in the AI era, and what's not?
sessionUpdates.description:
Follow-up to the EU session on AI-written PRs: what projects have tried since March (disclosure rules, AI pre-review bots, AGENTS.md, checked-in skills), and how they could tell it helped.

Picked from the community votes (46 votes). Projects: Any CNCF project; agent-sandbox, Kueue, JobSet.

sessionUpdates.title: Unconference: etcd-operator: from StatefulSets to a custom operator
sessionUpdates.description:
Why etcd-operator moved off StatefulSet to its own controller, how database operators manage pods across the ecosystem, and StatefulSet improvements on the way.

Picked from the community votes (11 votes). Projects: WG etcd-operator, SIG Apps.

sessionUpdates.title: Unconference: What standards are we missing for AI on Kubernetes?
sessionUpdates.description:
AI Conformance now covers 40+ certified platforms. What the platform contract should cover next for inference and agentic workloads, and how to keep it vendor-neutral.

Picked from the community votes (8 votes). Projects: Kubernetes SIGs and CNCF AI projects.

sessionUpdates.title: Unconference: SCI for OpenTelemetry
sessionUpdates.description:
How Software Carbon Intensity could be expressed in OpenTelemetry semantic conventions, with maintainer feedback before it goes to the SemConv SIG.

Picked from the community votes (15 votes). Projects: OpenTelemetry.
